title: Poison Control Centers Reauthorization Act of 2024
official_summary:
Poison Control Centers Reauthorization Act of 2024

This act reauthorizes through FY2029 several poison control center resources and services.

Specifically, the act reauthorizes (1) the national poison control center help line (i.e., the Poison Help line), (2) a national media campaign to educate the public and health care providers about the help line and other resources, and (3) a grant program to support the ability of poison control centers to provide services.

summary.headline: This law extends federal support for the national Poison Help line, a public awareness campaign, and grants to poison control centers through 2029.
summary.what_it_does: The law renews several federal poison control programs through fiscal year 2029. It continues the national Poison Help phone line. It also continues a national media campaign to teach the public and health care providers about the help line and other resources. And it continues a grant program that helps poison control centers provide their services.

who_it_affects.group: People who call the Poison Help line
who_it_affects.how: The national help line people call for advice about poisonings stays authorized through 2029.
They remain eligible for federal grants that support their ability to provide services.

who_it_affects.group: Doctors, nurses, and other health care providers
who_it_affects.how: They continue to be a target of a national campaign that informs them about the help line and related resources.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 26, 2024; programs are authorized through fiscal year 2029.
